candidates.statement: On E: y^2=x^3-25x with E(Q)=ZP+T, put W(Q)=H(x([m_*]Q)), so log W_j = a_E j^2 + O(c_E). On input u, the unique representative Q with W(Q) <= u+W_1 < max W(Q+-P) has index k ~ sqrt(log u); the unique representative R with kappa^-1 <= W(2Q)W(R)W_1 / (W(Q)^2 max W(R+-P)) <= kappa has index k^2. g(u)=W(R) has a single-fold graph and delta(log u)^2 < log g(u) < u log u.

final.justification: No construction of a single-fold (or any) Julia-Robinson-type relation from archimedean height comparisons was found. It supplies the object missing since 1974 by a mechanism Pell cannot provide: a bounded multiplicative window tests only linear index relations when log-growth is linear, but tests k^2 = r when log-growth is quadratic. Downgrade pressure: the bridge was explicitly posed (Pheidas Q9, c. 2005), and Poonen 2002 (in L) already squares indices on rank-one curves p-adically. The eureka content is therefore narrow: the archimedean window plus representative selection that yields uniqueness. Confidence lower than the analyst's provisional N3.

candidates.name: Single-fold machine compiler: clock register, dyadic base window, exact-halt identity
candidates.statement: A Minsky run is encoded in base B=2^w; a clock register forces B in (2(C+T),4(C+T)], which contains exactly one power of two, and summing state equations gives B*I_h = H (halt exactly at the last step), so each halting input has exactly one complete witness.

family_D.label: D3 (provisional)
family_D.rests_on: C1 alone (the elliptic-height single-fold growth function). C2 is its N2 sub-lemma; C3 is the N2 enabling step that makes C1's quasi-polynomial growth sufficient.
family_D.falls_to: D2 if (a) Test 4 arm B for C1 exceeds the calibrated threshold; (b) an expert (Pheidas, Poonen, Shlapentokh, Zahidi, Cornelissen, Matiyasevich) identifies an earlier archimedean height-window or height-based index-squaring construction, e.g. in responses to AIM Question 9; or (c) once C3's weakened target is known, a Pell-only single-fold quasi-polynomial growth function turns out to be easy. Then the decisive step would be C3, which is N2.
family_D.not_transfer: Neron-Tate theory, Mordell-Weil, descent and the rank-one curve are N0 transfer (C6, C7). The candidate is the use of quadratic log-growth of heights, with a bounded-error multiplicative window, to square a hidden index inside a single-fold system. That use has no found precedent, so the transfer exclusion does not apply. The bridge direction itself (elliptic curves instead of Pell) is not new: it was posed by Pheidas.
family_D.correctness_caveat: All grades are conditional on correctness. This is an extraordinary claim (open since 1974) and unrefereed. The family analyst found no gap and reports that Lean proves the comparator verbatim (no sorry/axiom/native_decide; one kernel decide enumeration), but Lean was not compiled in either pass. The Lean route through the arithmetic geometry is independent of the paper's (full 2-descent, in-house Mordell-Weil and canonical height).
family_D.compression_note: No step-3b compression run. power_of_growth is abstract in g, so C1 is a clean plug-in: a natural knockout experiment is to ask a prover for ANY g satisfying the hypothesis of power_of_growth.

provenance_flag.explanation: The bibliography has no 2025-2026 entries; the latest is cco2024 (Le Matematiche, received 2024-09-30). Its full text has no AI-assistance wording, and its authors are human with institutional funding. Web searches for the single-fold conjecture together with ChatGPT, GPT-5 or OpenAI found only (i) press on other OpenAI results (GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra and the Cycle Double Cover conjecture, the-decoder 2026-07-11; Scientific American), and (ii) third-party indexes of the 2026-10-06 OpenAI release that list this family. No model-produced earlier work on single-fold representations or on elliptic-height growth relations was found. The nearest precedents (Pheidas Q9 c. 2005; Poonen 2002; CCO 2023/2024) are human and pre-LLM or AI-free.
